entries.89694a0979baf72f: A materials manufacturer that makes ferrite powders, such as electrophotographic carriers used in multifunction devices and printers, and oxygen absorbers for food.
entries.8e5270d8ba47c2d3: This is based on the company history stating that it began full-scale supply of two-component carriers to domestic PPC manufacturers in 1970, developed shape-processing technology in 1975 and resin-coated carriers in 1978, and began full-scale sales of ferrite carriers in 1984.
entries.9f8fac2e66271a76: This is based on the business policy stating that it will restructure its product portfolio to expand investment in focus products and developing products, and that it plans investments, including a new coat plant and a new research and development building, that are the largest in any past medium-term plan.
entries.c27e7fc2a796fa08: Its strength lies in its accumulated powder technology since its founding; for ferrite carriers it has established shape-processing techniques such as flattening and spheroidization and resin coating technology, and it has long supplied copier and printer manufacturers in Japan.
entries.caf08ec97314c098: This business mainly produces and sells oxygen absorbers and oxygen indicators for quality preservation, primarily for the food industry. Its consolidated subsidiary Wonder Keep Takahagi Co., Ltd. manufactures the company's products. Revenue from external customers in the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥965 million.
entries.d9262f2682a1bcf5: This is the event at which it became the current company name.
entries.dcb1d95c8cf2b42e: Using ferrite powder as its raw material, it produces and sells electrophotographic carriers for copiers and printers, and various functional fine particles for new applications developed by applying powder technology. In addition, it also produces and sells oxygen scavengers and oxygen indicators used for food quality preservation.
entries.de1a6b7912d93fcd: The Functional Materials Business accounts for about 9 tenths of net sales, and its core is electrophotographic carriers for multifunction devices and printers. It passed ¥10 billion in net sales in March 2017, and has been selected for the Ministry of Economy, Trade and Industry's "2020 edition of Global Niche Top Companies 100 Selection."
entries.e4956255992362c6: This business mainly produces and sells carriers for electrophotography for the multifunction printer and printer industries, and various functional fine particles for new applications that apply powder technology. Its main affiliate is the U.S. sales subsidiary Powdertech International Corp. Revenue from external customers in the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥8,174 million.

entries.e6acab1fdf1654fa: This is based on the segment information stating that external revenue from the functional materials business of ¥8,174 million accounts for most of consolidated revenue of ¥9,140 million, and on the company history stating that revenue surpassed ¥10 billion in March 2017 and that it was selected for the Global Niche Top 100 Companies in June 2020.
entries.eee1669f640f8d73: Established in 1966 as Nihon Teppun Co., Ltd., jointly funded by Mitsui Mining & Smelting and Nan'yu Shosha Co., Ltd., and renamed to its current name in 1989. Its headquarters and plant are located in Kashiwa, Chiba Prefecture, and the number of employees for the fiscal year ended March 2026 is 262. Mitsui Mining & Smelting holds 35.4% of the company's voting rights, and Nan'yu Shosha Co., Ltd. holds 37.7%; it is an other affiliated company.
